figma.name: figma
figma.description: Bring Figma into a HyperFrames video - rendered assets, brand tokens, components, storyboard frames as reconstructed motion (frames read as states, not slides), shaders and connector-assisted motion. Use when the person pastes a figma.com link or asks to use a Figma design, frame, logo or brand.

hyperframes.name: hyperframes
hyperframes.description: Read first to make, edit, animate or render any video with HyperFrames (HTML rendered to video), including launch films, explainers, music videos, charts, maps, vertical clips, title cards, captions and overlays. Holds the render contract, the work loop and what each kind of video needs.

hyperframes-cli.name: hyperframes-cli
hyperframes-cli.description: HyperFrames CLI - scaffold, check frames, edit timelines, preview, render, share and project history; read JSON and recover from failures.

hyperframes-registry.name: hyperframes-registry
hyperframes-registry.description: About 450 ready-made HyperFrames blocks and components installed as editable source - transitions, overlays, titles, kinetic type, captions, charts, map overlays, 3D, camera moves. Use it before hand-building any named visual (CRT scanlines, glitch, film grain, a chart); also for hyperframes add and catalog.

media-use.name: media-use
media-use.description: Get or make any media for a HyperFrames video - music, sound effects, images, icons, logos, voiceover, avatar and generated video, transcripts, cutouts, colour grades and looks - with HeyGen or free local tools, and mix placed audio. Also for footage that looks dark, flat or dull, or should be stylized or hidden.

remotion-to-hyperframes.name: remotion-to-hyperframes
remotion-to-hyperframes.description: Bring existing video code or footage into HyperFrames and verify it frame by frame against the original - Remotion first, also Motion Canvas, Lottie, Three.js, p5.js, canvas or plain HTML/CSS animation, or renders from Manim, After Effects or Blender. Use to port, convert, migrate or reuse work made with another tool.

reverse-any-video.name: reverse-any-video
reverse-any-video.description: Rebuild any video file as an editable HyperFrames project - motion graphics, talking heads, live action or AI-generated footage - checked against the original frame by frame. Use to reverse, recreate, remake, replicate or copy a video, or 「复刻这个视频」「照着这个视频做一个」.

slideshow.name: slideshow
slideshow.description: Build a HyperFrames slideshow to present live - slides, fragment reveals, branching hotspots and presenter mode with speaker notes, served by `hyperframes present` - or turn an existing page into one. Use when the person wants a deck or presentation rather than a rendered video.

style-sampling.name: style-sampling
style-sampling.description: Make a new episode in a proven video style - Collage Explainer, Finance Explainer, Animated Science Explainer, 3D Brand Explainer, 3D True Crime - on the person's topic. Use for "an episode of", "in the style of", "sample this style", 「用这个风格做一集」. One video to copy is reverse-any-video.
